title: Etale slice through a separable point of a smooth morphism
statement: Let f:X\to S be smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and x a point of X [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] such that the residue-field map \kappa(f(x))\to\kappa(x) is etale (finite separable). There are an affine scheme Z, a morphism i:Z\to X and z\in Z with i(z)=x and i followed by f etale.

proof.text: Attach the existing proved declaration, not a new Lean statement. Its proof takes the smooth etale normal form to affine space, constructs an etale slice of affine space at the finite separable point, and pulls that slice back to X. The exact declaration and proof were read in Slicing.lean:184-210.

theorem Smooth.exists_etale_comp_of_etale_residueFieldMap {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Smooth f] {x : X} (hx : (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.Etale) :
    ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (ι : Z ⟶ X) (z : Z), IsAffine Z ∧ Etale (ι ≫ f) ∧ ι z = x
